scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
programs: every P-F02 census program with a complete vector, cluster = nearest centroid
tests: continuous: cluster mean vs 2000-permutation band of cluster labels; categorical: share vs band
material_rule: any feature outside its band for the start-anchored or periodic cluster
